description: This image displays a user interface for the "Reuse Ingestion" feature, focused on the "Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Vector" step, which is step 2 in a two-step process (Step 1 is "Input Type Selection"). The form is populated with the following details: "Name" is "ES616_10m", "Country" is "ES Spain/España", and "Region" is "ES616 Jaén". Below these fields, there are two tabs for data upload: "File Upload" (currently active) and "URL Upload". The "File Upload" section provides a "Drag and Drop OR Upload Dataset/s" area. Supported file formats for upload are specified as ".tif, .TIF, .tiff, .TIFF, .zip, .h5, .gpkg". An "Attribute Name*" field is set to "Code_18", with a description stating: "Enter Attribute Name from Dataset (column from the attribute table) which shall be used as Input Parameter for the Class Code. Values of the selected attribute column must only contain upper- and lower-case letters. numbers." A spatial resolution of "10 meters" is also selected.
